scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: I'm inquiring about the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a while back and I'm still waiting to hear back about the outcome. Can you tell me if it's still pending or if a decision has been made?
dialogue.agent: I've located your application. According to our records, the action taken on your loan application was that the loan was purchased. This means your loan application was approved and the loan was subsequently sold to another institution, Fannie Mae. Is there anything specific you'd like to know about your loan terms or details?

dialogue.user: So my loan was approved and sold to Fannie Mae. That's good to know, thank you. Can you tell me what my interest rate is and what the total costs of the loan are? I'd like to understand the of my loan.
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 7.5% and the total loan costs are $12,027.85.

dialogue.user: So my interest rate is 7.5% and the total loan costs are $12,027.85. That helps me understand the financial side of things. Can you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And what type of loan product was I approved for, specifically?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is classified as a Conventional: First Lien loan product. Additionally, your loan is not considered a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user:
So my loan is a Conventional: First Lien loan product, and it's not considered a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, which is good to know. I've got a better understanding of my loan now. One last question: Can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is? I'd like to understand that part of my application. 

Also, I think I have all the information I need; I'm leaning towards being satisfied with the interaction so far.
dialogue.agent:
Unfortunately, the debt-to-income ratio field is not available in your loan record. 

You're welcome, and I'm glad I could provide you with the information you needed. Feel free to end the conversation if you're satisfied, or ask if you have any other questions, even though I won't be able to provide additional information beyond what's in your loan record.

dialogue.user:
I appreciate your help and the information you've provided. I've got a good understanding of my loan terms and details. Since I've asked all my questions and you're not able to provide additional information, I'm going to end the conversation here.

I'm satisfied with the interaction. You were clear, concise, and provided all the information available in my loan record. I appreciate your professionalism and courtesy. Thank you for your help!

<Satisfied> I'm satisfied because you provided all the necessary information about my loan, answered my questions clearly, and were professional throughout our conversation.
